head.subtitle.text: Zoom in to read. A click on a skill shows where I used it. Under “Projects” you can filter by project.
head.subtitle.note: Subtitle in the header, below the title of the map. “Projects” is the button head.projects.

head.search.note: Placeholder and screen reader label of the search field in the header.

zoom.in.note: Screen reader label of the button + in the header.

zoom.out.note: Screen reader label of the button − in the header.

zoom.fit.note: Button in the header that shows the whole map, one word.

head.projects.note: Button in the header that opens the project list, one word.

status.connecting.note: Save state in the header of the owner while the page connects to the database.

status.offline.note: Save state in the header of the owner when the page has no database.

status.pending.note: Save state in the header of the owner while a change is saved.

status.saved.note: Save state in the header of the owner after every change is saved, one word.

status.readonly.note: Save state in the header of the owner after the database refused a write.

status.error.note: Save state in the header of the owner after a failed write. {code} is the error code of the database, or status.unknownError.

status.unknownError.note: Takes the place of the error code in status.error when a failed write has no code, small letters.

head.areas.note: Screen reader label of the row of area buttons in the header.

map.label.note: Screen reader label of the map while it has no area.

map.labelAreas.note: Screen reader label of the map. {count} is the number of its areas.

map.hint.text: scroll or drag to zoom and move
map.hint.note: Hint at the bottom left of the map, small letters and no full stop.

map.notLoaded.note: Panel heading when the drawing library did not load, no full stop.

map.notLoadedHint.text: The drawing library did not load. Please reload the page.

edit.bar.note: Label of the bar above the map while the owner assigns skills to a project. It shows in capitals.

action.done.note: Button that ends the assignment of skills, in the bar above the map and in the panel, one word.

time.title.note: Heading of the time range filter below the panel. It shows in capitals.

time.all.note: The range that the time range filter shows while it covers every year, small letters.

time.reset.note: Button of the time range filter that covers every year again.

time.from.note: Screen reader label of the start handle of the time range filter.

time.to.note: Screen reader label of the end handle of the time range filter.

time.setToStation.note: Screen reader label of the bar of a station above the time range filter. {name} is the name of the station, {when} its dates as the map writes them.

overview.heading.note: Heading of the overview, for example “9 skills in 3 areas”. {skills} is overview.skills or overview.skillsInRange, {areas} is overview.areas or overview.areasInRange.

overview.skills.note: Part of overview.heading. {count} is the number of skills of the map.

overview.skillsInRange.note: Part of overview.heading while a time range is set. {shown} is the number of skills in the range, {count} the number of all skills.

overview.areas.note: Part of overview.heading. {count} is the number of areas.

overview.areasInRange.note: Part of overview.heading while a time range is set. {count} is the number of areas with a skill in the range.

overview.linesSkill.text: The lines connect skills that I used at the same stations: the more often, the stronger. A click on a skill shows its lines and where I used it.
overview.linesSkill.note: Overview text below the heading while the lines connect two skills each.

overview.linesCategory.text: The lines connect categories whose skills I used at the same stations: the more often, the stronger. A click on a skill shows its lines and where I used it.
overview.linesCategory.note: Overview text below the heading while the lines connect two categories each.

overview.linesMixed.text: The lines connect skills with categories whose skills I used at the same stations: the more often, the stronger. A click on a skill shows its lines and where I used it.
overview.linesMixed.note: Overview text below the heading while the lines connect a skill with a category each.

overview.noLines.text: A click on a skill shows where I used it.
overview.noLines.note: Overview text below the heading while the map shows no lines.

overview.noStationInRange.text: No station lies in this time range.
overview.noStationInRange.note: Overview text when the time range holds no station.

overview.projects.note: Overview heading of the part about the projects. It shows in capitals.

projects.loading.note: Text while the projects load: in the overview, in the panel of a skill and in the project list.

text.one: {count} project. A click on a project highlights its skills in the map.
text.other: {count} projects. A click on a project highlights its skills in the map.

overview.projectsReader.note: Overview text for a reader. {count} is the number of projects.

text.one: {shown} of {count} project in the time range. A click on a project highlights its skills in the map.
text.other: {shown} of {count} projects in the time range. A click on a project highlights its skills in the map.

overview.projectsReaderInRange.note: Overview text for a reader while a time range is set. {shown} is the number of projects in the range, {count} the number of all projects.

overview.noProjectDatabase.text: The project database cannot be reached here.
overview.noProjectDatabase.note: Overview text for the owner when the page has no database.

overview.projectsOwner.note: Overview text for the owner. {count} is the number of his projects.

text.one: {count} project created, {shown} in the time range.
text.other: {count} projects created, {shown} in the time range.

overview.projectsOwnerInRange.note: Overview text for the owner while a time range is set. {count} is the number of his projects, {shown} the number in the range.

overview.openProjects.note: Button in the overview that opens the project list.

overview.byRating.note: Overview heading above the ratings. It shows in capitals.

rating.veryGood.note: Rating 3 of a skill, small letters: in the overview, in the panel of a skill and in the skill form. The panel heading of the rating starts it with a capital letter.

rating.good.note: Rating 2 of a skill, small letters, as rating.veryGood.

rating.basic.note: Rating 1 of a skill, small letters, as rating.veryGood.

rating.ai.text: used with AI, no routine of my own
rating.ai.note: The rating “AI” of a skill, small letters, as rating.veryGood.

rating.unused.note: Rating 0 of a skill, small letters, as rating.veryGood.

overview.areasHeading.note: Overview heading above the list of areas. It shows in capitals.

overview.noAreas.text: No areas yet. An area collects categories, for example “Software development” with “Languages” and “Frontend”.
overview.noAreas.note: Overview text for the owner of a map without areas.

overview.addArea.note: Button in the overview that opens the form for a new area.

overview.stations.note: Overview heading above the stations. It shows in capitals.

overview.noStations.text: No stations yet. A station is an employer, an education or a private project with a time range.
overview.noStations.note: Overview text for the owner of a map without stations.

overview.addStation.note: Button in the overview that opens the form for a new station.

overview.privateProjects.note: Overview heading above the private projects. It shows in capitals.

overview.map.note: Overview heading of the part about the map itself, for its owner. It shows in capitals.

overview.mapTitle.note: Overview text for the owner. {title} is the title of the map, {place} the sentence of the host that says where the map lives.

overview.export.note: Button in the overview that saves the map as a map file.

overview.editTitle.note: Button in the overview that opens the form for the title of the map.

overview.back.note: Button at the top of the panel that goes back to the overview.

rating.skills.note: Line above the panel heading of a rating. {count} is the number of skills with the rating.

text.one: {shown} of {count} skill in the time range
text.other: {shown} of {count} skills in the time range

rating.skillsInRange.note: Line above the panel heading of a rating while a time range is set. {shown} is the number of these skills in the range, {count} the number of all skills with the rating.

area.addGroup.note: Button in the panel of an area that opens the form for a new category.

area.edit.note: Button in the panel of an area that opens its form.

action.delete.note: Button that deletes a skill, an area, a station, a project or a category, or asks first, one word.

group.addSkill.note: Button in the panel of a category that opens the form for a new skill.

group.edit.note: Button in the panel of a category that opens its form.

group.empty.text: No skills in this category yet.
group.empty.note: Panel text of a category without skills.

action.edit.note: Button that opens the form of a skill or a project, one word.

confirm.deleteSkill.note: Question before the delete of a skill. {name} is the name of the skill.

text.one: Delete “{name}”? The skill also disappears from {count} project. This cannot be undone.
text.other: Delete “{name}”? The skill also disappears from {count} projects. This cannot be undone.

confirm.deleteSkillInProjects.note: Question before the delete of a skill that projects use. {name} is the name of the skill, {count} the number of its projects.

action.deleteForever.note: Button in a question before a delete that deletes.

action.cancel.note: Button that closes a question or a form without a change, one word.

skill.usedAt.note: Panel heading of a skill above its stations. It shows in capitals.

skill.noStation.text: Rating from the CV, not linked to a station.
skill.noStation.note: Panel text of a skill without a station.

skill.indirect.note: A station where others used the skill: in the panel of a skill, and in the data of the page for the short name of the station. {station} is the name or the short name of the station.

skill.inProjects.note: Panel heading of a skill above its projects. It shows in capitals.

skill.noProject.note: Panel text of a skill that no project uses.

action.back.note: Button at the top of a form that closes it without a change.

action.create.note: Button that saves a new entry from its form, one word.

action.save.note: Button that saves the changes of a form, one word.

form.name.note: Label of the name field of a form.

form.newGroup.note: Heading of the form for a new category.

form.editGroup.note: Heading of the form of a category.

form.groupNotEmpty.text: The category can be deleted once it has no skills.
form.groupNotEmpty.note: Text in the form of a category that still has skills.

form.standardHintOn.text: A standard skill counts for every station from “Standard since” on, in the station views and in the time range filter. The panel shows the note instead of the stations. It gets no lines. This holds while “Standard skills” is on in the configuration.
form.standardHintOn.note: Text in the skill form below the fields of a standard skill. “Standard since” is form.standardSince, “Standard skills” a setting of the force menu.

form.standardHintOff.text: “Standard skills” is off in the configuration. The note has no effect, and the skill counts only at its own stations, like any other.
form.standardHintOff.note: Text in the skill form while the setting “Standard skills” of the force menu is off.

form.standardSuggestion.text: Standard since {station} in all stations and projects
form.standardSuggestion.note: The note that the skill form suggests for a standard skill. The owner can change it, and it is saved with the skill. {station} is the short name of the station.

form.newSkill.note: Heading of the form for a new skill.

form.editSkill.note: Heading of the form of a skill.

form.group.note: Label of the category field of the skill form.

form.rating.note: Label of the rating field of the skill form.

form.places.note: Label above the stations in the skill form.

form.noStations.text: No stations yet. You create them in the overview under “Stations”.
form.noStations.note: Text in the skill form of a map without stations. “Stations” is the heading overview.stations.

form.standard.note: Label above the fields of a standard skill in the skill form.

form.standardSkill.note: Check box in the skill form that makes the skill a standard skill.

form.standardSince.note: Label of the field in the skill form that names the station from which a standard skill counts.

form.standardText.note: Label of the field in the skill form for the note of a standard skill, which the panel shows.

form.cannotSave.text: Saving is not possible right now.
form.cannotSave.note: Error of a form when the page cannot save.

form.nameMissing.note: Error of a form without a name.

form.standardTextMissing.text: Please enter a note for the standard skill.

form.newArea.note: Heading of the form for a new area.

form.editArea.note: Heading of the form of an area.

form.color.note: Label of the color field of the area form.

form.startPoint.note: Label above the x and y fields of the area form.

form.startPointHint.text: The area hangs on its start point. You can also drag the point in the force menu, and a configuration saves its own start points.
form.startPointHint.note: Text in the area form below the start point.

form.startPointInvalid.text: The start point needs two numbers.

form.newStation.note: Heading of the form for a new station.

form.editStation.note: Heading of the form of a station.

form.stationExample.note: Placeholder of the name field of the station form: the name of a made-up company.

form.short.note: Label of the short name field of the station form.

form.shortExample.note: Placeholder of the short name field of the station form: the short name of form.stationExample.

form.kind.note: Label of the field of the station form that says if the station is an employer, an education or a private project.

station.kindEmployer.note: Kind of a station, in the station form and above the panel heading of a station.

station.kindEducation.note: Kind of a station: a school or a study, as station.kindEmployer.

station.kindPrivate.note: Kind of a station: work outside an employer, as station.kindEmployer.

form.when.note: Label of the dates field of the station form.

form.whenExample.note: Placeholder of the dates field of the station form. The dates take the form MM.YYYY or MM/YYYY. “since” marks a station that still runs. The page reads only the words since, seit, today, present and heute, in every language: keep one of them.

form.months.note: Label of the months field of the station form.

form.monthsHint.text: Without a value, the whole time range counts. The months fill the experience ring of the skills of this station.
form.monthsHint.note: Text in the station form below the months field. The experience ring is the ring around a skill on the map.

form.note.note: Label of the description field of the station form.

form.whenInvalid.text: The time range needs a date such as 03.2013, 2013 or “since 05.2026”.
form.whenInvalid.note: Error of the station form and the project form when the dates field holds another word or no date. “since” marks a station that still runs. The page reads only the words since, seit, today, present and heute, in every language: keep one of them.

form.monthsInvalid.text: The months must be a number from 0 up.

confirm.deleteWith.note: Question before the delete of an area or a station. {name} is its name, {parts} one or more sentences of confirm.area… or confirm.station….

confirm.areaContent.text: With the area, {groups} and {skills} disappear too.
confirm.areaContent.note: Part of confirm.deleteWith for an area. {groups} is confirm.groups, {skills} is count.skills.

confirm.groups.note: Part of confirm.areaContent. {count} is the number of categories of the area.

count.skills.note: A number of skills: in confirm.areaContent, in the panel of a project, in the bar above the map and in confirm.deleteProject. {count} is the number.

text.one: The skills also disappear from {count} project.
text.other: The skills also disappear from {count} projects.

confirm.areaProjects.note: Part of confirm.deleteWith for an area whose skills projects use. {count} is the number of these projects.

confirm.areaEmpty.note: Part of confirm.deleteWith for an area without categories.

confirm.stationSkills.note: Part of confirm.deleteWith for a station. {count} is the number of skills with the station.

text.one: {count} project of this station is deleted with it.
text.other: {count} projects of this station are deleted with it.

confirm.stationProjects.note: Part of confirm.deleteWith for a station. {count} is the number of its projects.

text.one: {count} standard skill counts from this station on and becomes a normal skill.
text.other: {count} standard skills count from this station on and become normal skills.

confirm.stationStandard.note: Part of confirm.deleteWith for a station. {count} is the number of standard skills that count from this station on.

confirm.stationEmpty.text: No skill and no project depends on this station.
confirm.stationEmpty.note: Part of confirm.deleteWith for a station without skills and projects.

titleForm.heading.note: Heading of the form for the title of a map.

titleForm.hint.text: The title shows at the top of the map and in the name of the exported file.

titleForm.notSaved.text: The title could not be saved. {message}
titleForm.notSaved.note: Error of the title form. {message} is the message of the host, or empty.

station.edit.note: Button in the panel of a station that opens its form.

station.outOfRange.note: Part of the line above the panel heading of a station outside the time range, after its kind and dates, small letters.

station.skills.note: Panel heading of a station above its skills. {count} is their number. It shows in capitals.

search.hits.note: Panel heading of a search. {count} is the number of skills found, {query} the text of the search.

search.enter.text: Enter zooms to the first hit.
search.enter.note: Panel text below the skills found. Enter is the key.

search.enterInRange.text: {count} of them in the time range. Enter zooms to the first hit.
search.enterInRange.note: Panel text below the skills found while a time range is set. {count} is the number of them in the range.

search.none.text: No skill on the map contains this text.
search.none.note: Panel text when the search finds no skill.

notice.noDatabase.text: The project database cannot be reached in this view.
notice.noDatabase.note: Notice for the owner in the project panels when the page has no database.

notice.noDatabaseHint.text: The project database cannot be reached in this view. {hint}
notice.noDatabaseHint.note: Notice as notice.noDatabase, with a sentence of the host. {hint} is that sentence.

notice.readOnly.text: Saving was refused. The projects are read-only for this visit.
notice.readOnly.note: Notice for the owner in the project panels after the database refused a write.

project.noSkillsReader.note: Panel text of a project without skills, for a reader.

project.noSkillsEditing.note: Panel text of a project without skills while the owner assigns skills.

project.noSkillsOwner.text: No skills yet. “Assign skills” starts the choice in the map.
project.noSkillsOwner.note: Panel text of a project without skills, for the owner. “Assign skills” is the button project.assign.

project.removeSkill.note: Screen reader label of the button × next to a skill of a project. {name} is the name of the skill.

project.remove.note: Tooltip of the button × next to a skill of a project, one word.

project.notOnMap.note: Panel heading of a project above its skills that the map does not have. It shows in capitals.

project.noName.note: Name of a project without a name, for its owner.

projects.noLines.note: Mark next to a project in the list that is a base stack, small letters.

projects.skillCountTitle.note: Tooltip of the number of skills at the right of a project in the list, one word.

projects.add.note: Button below the projects of a station in the list that opens the form for a new project there.

projects.heading.note: Panel heading of the project list.

projects.intro.text: A project collects the skills that I used in it. Its number is on the left, the number of its skills on the right.
projects.intro.note: Panel text below the heading of the project list.

projects.new.note: Button in the project list that opens the form for a new project.

projects.none.text: No projects yet. “New project” creates the first one.
projects.none.note: Panel text of an empty project list, for the owner. “New project” is the button projects.new.

projects.emptyStations.note: Panel heading above the stations without projects. It shows in capitals.

station.private.note: Name of the group of all private projects in the project list and in the project form.

project.assign.note: Button in the panel of a project that starts to assign skills in the map.

confirm.deleteProject.text: Delete “{name}” with {skills}? This cannot be undone.
confirm.deleteProject.note: Question before the delete of a project. {name} is its name, {skills} is count.skills.

projects.back.note: Button at the top of the panel of a project and of the project form that goes back to the project list.

project.number.note: Part of the line above the panel heading of a project. {number} is the number of the project in the list.

project.baseReader.text: Base stack: used at the whole station
project.baseReader.note: Mark in the panel of a project that is a base stack, for a reader.

project.baseOwner.text: Base stack: hangs on the station, without lines
project.baseOwner.note: Mark in the panel of a project that is a base stack, for the owner.

edit.crumb.note: Line above the panel heading while the owner assigns skills to a project. {station} is the station of the project.

edit.help.text: A click on a skill in the map adds it, a second click removes it. The search at the top highlights skills, and Enter zooms to the first hit.
edit.help.note: Panel text while the owner assigns skills to a project. Enter is the key.

form.backToProject.note: Button at the top of the form of a project that goes back to the project.

form.newProject.note: Heading of the form for a new project.

form.editProject.note: Heading of the form of a project.

form.station.note: Label of the station field of the project form.

form.projectWhen.note: Label of the dates field of the project form.

form.projectWhenExample.note: Placeholder of the dates field of the project form. The dates take the form MM.YYYY.

form.order.note: Label of the number field of the project form.

form.base.note: Check box of the project form that makes the project a base stack.

form.baseHint.text: A base stack collects the skills that belong to the whole station. It gets no lines.
form.baseHint.note: Text in the project form below form.base.

form.orderInvalid.text: The number must be a whole number from 0 up.

form.projectGone.note: Error of the project form when another tab deleted the project.

experience.text.note: Tooltip of a skill on the map, after its name. {span} is experience.months or experience.years, {year} the year of its last use.

experience.textAsOf.note: Tooltip as experience.text while a time range ends before today. {month} is the last month of the range, as MM.YYYY in the format of the language.

experience.months.note: Part of experience.text. {count} is the number of months.

experience.years.note: Part of experience.text. {years} is the number of years, rounded to a half year, in the number format of the language.

file.home.note: Link in the header of a map page of the site to the start page. One word.

file.open.note: Button in the header: opens a map file (JSON) in the browser.

file.choose.note: Screen reader name of the hidden file field behind “Open map file”.

file.export.note: Button in the header of the owner: saves the map as a map file. One word.

header.reader.text: Zoom in to read. A click on a skill shows where it was used.
header.reader.note: Line below the title of a map of the site, for a reader.

header.owner.text: Create areas, stations, categories, skills and projects.
header.owner.note: Line below the title of a map of the site, for its owner. A hint of the site can follow.

download.title.note: Label in front of the download buttons SVG, PNG, PNG 4× and PDF below the panel. One word.

download.svg.text: Vector graphic of the map as it looks now
download.svg.note: Tooltip of the download button SVG.

download.png.text: Picture of the map at twice its size
download.png.note: Tooltip of the download button PNG.

download.png4.text: Picture of the map at four times its size, for print and zoom
download.png4.note: Tooltip of the download button PNG 4×.

download.pdf.text: PDF with vectors and searchable text
download.pdf.note: Tooltip of the download button PDF.

download.foot.range.note: Part of the foot line of a downloaded file, after the title and the date. {range} is the time range, for example “2019 – 2024”.

download.loadingPdf.note: Download state on the first PDF, while the page loads the PDF library.

download.making.note: Download state while the page makes the file. {kind} is SVG, PNG or PDF.

download.drawFailed.text: The picture of the map could not be drawn.
download.drawFailed.note: Error of the download of a PNG.

download.tooLarge.text: The picture is too large for this browser. Please choose PNG instead of PNG 4×.
download.tooLarge.note: Error of the download of a PNG. PNG and PNG 4× are the names of two buttons.

download.pdfFailed.text: The PDF library could not load. Please try again later.
download.pdfFailed.note: Error of the download of a PDF.

download.pdfMissing.text: The font of the PDF cannot draw these characters of the map: {characters}. The PDF shows “�” in their place.
download.pdfMissing.note: Warning below the download buttons before a PDF, when a name or the title holds characters that the font of the PDF (Noto Sans: Latin, Greek and Cyrillic) cannot draw, for example Chinese or an emoji. {characters} lists them, each with its code point, for example “日 (U+65E5), 本 (U+672C)”. Keep the replacement character “�”. A button download.pdfAnyway follows.

download.pdfAnyway.note: Button after the warning download.pdfMissing: it downloads the PDF with the replacement characters.

download.scaleLimit.text: This browser allows only {scale} times the size.
download.scaleLimit.note: Sentence after the download of a PNG that is smaller than asked. {scale} is a decimal number, for example 2.5.

download.fontMissing.text: The font of the page could not be embedded, so the file names fallback fonts.
download.fontMissing.note: Sentence after a download of an SVG or PNG.

download.done.note: Download state after the browser saved the file. {name} is the file name. More sentences can follow.

download.failed.note: Error of a download without a reason of its own.
